description: In pkix-lint/src/report.rs line 55, EvaluationReport derives Clone, Debug, Default but not PartialEq. Finding derives PartialEq. An EvaluationReport that bundles Findings cannot be compared with == in tests, forcing callers to destructure. Since all constituent types (Finding, DeviatedFinding, Cow<'static,str>, u64, usize) implement PartialEq, adding the derive is straightforward and makes the type more useful for assertion-heavy tests.
title: EvaluationReport missing PartialEq derive — cannot test equality in integration tests
